# FundBridge AI - Python AI/NLP service dependencies.
#
# Version policy: compatible-release ranges here, with exact versions captured
# in `requirements.lock.txt` (generated by `pip freeze` after a successful
# install). The lock file is what makes an experiment reproducible; this file is
# what makes the dependency intent readable.
#
# Install:
#   python -m venv .venv
#   .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# PyTorch is installed CPU-only from PyTorch's own index. The embedding model
# (all-MiniLM-L6-v2, 384-dim, ~90MB) runs fast enough on CPU for this corpus
# size, and the CUDA build is roughly ten times larger for no benefit here.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu

# --- Web framework ---------------------------------------------------------
fastapi>=0.115,<0.116
uvicorn[standard]>=0.34,<0.35
pydantic>=2.10,<3.0
pydantic-settings>=2.7,<3.0
python-multipart>=0.0.20,<0.1

# --- HTTP client (backend -> AI service, AI service -> LLM) ----------------
httpx>=0.28,<0.29

# --- Document extraction ---------------------------------------------------
# PyMuPDF for PDF text with layout awareness; python-docx for Word documents.
# No OCR dependency: it is only added if genuinely scanned documents appear.
#
# Import it as `import pymupdf`, NOT the older `import fitz` — 1.28 emits a
# deprecation warning for `fitz` and will remove that alias.
PyMuPDF>=1.25,<2.0
python-docx>=1.1,<2.0

# --- NLP / embeddings ------------------------------------------------------
torch>=2.5,<3.0
sentence-transformers>=3.3,<4.0
numpy>=2.0,<3.0

# --- Classical ML and analysis (research layer) ----------------------------
pandas>=2.2,<3.0
scikit-learn>=1.6,<2.0
scipy>=1.14,<2.0

# --- Explainability --------------------------------------------------------
shap>=0.46,<0.47

# --- Database (read-only access for the retrieval index) -------------------
# The AI service reads scheme chunks and writes embeddings. All user-facing
# writes go through the Node backend, which owns authorisation.
psycopg[binary]>=3.2,<4.0

# --- LLM provider ----------------------------------------------------------
# Optional at runtime: without an API key the service returns deterministic,
# template-based explanations rather than failing or inventing facts.
anthropic>=0.42,<1.0
# Groq is OpenAI-protocol compatible; this SDK drives both.
openai>=1.40,<3.0
